title: 第二章 入门，少女
content_zh:
落神宗,山门。

    巨大的山门,高足有百丈,正中央鎏金镌刻“落神宗”三个大字,右下则是一行小字“修行万道,不忘本心”。每一字都显得古朴苍劲,却散发出一股凌厉的剑气,任谁都不敢仰视。

    此刻的落神宗山门外,早已聚集了很多人,都是来参加落神宗弟子的选拔。这些人中尤以少年居多,大约有数万,其余都是一些陪同来的仆人或是家人。

    或三五成群,或两两成对。有的面带焦虑,有的则显得十分轻松。而来参加选拔的少年大都是锦衣华服,显然没有背景的少年能够通过选拔的是很少的。

    这并非是落神宗嫌贫爱富,或是有人收受贿赂。而是寻常百姓家,即便子女天资再高,没有成功引动星力也是枉然。想要引动星力,就必须有星阵师布置牵引星阵,才能引动星力。

    而一般第一次引动星力,需要的时间非常不固定。短的可以在一个时辰就成功引动星力,而长则数月乃至更长的时间才行。寻常百姓没有那么多的钱财去请星阵师,故而一直以来加入落神宗的弟子,都是以世家子弟居多。

    江尘的衣着还算得体,虽算不上华丽,看上去却也像个世家的少爷。只不过,独自一人穿梭于人群中,江尘的心中却是有些羡慕的。不管眼前这些少年,是在家人或是仆人的陪伴下前来的,至少都是有人相伴的,而他却是孤家寡人一个。这让江尘的心中很是羡慕,甚至有些小嫉妒了。

    江尘找了空地坐下,按照老道士传授的静心诀,努力使自己的心平静下来。

    “你怎么一个人在这里,没有人送你来这里吗?”一个只有十岁左右的小女孩,眨着眼睛,好奇的盯着江尘,问道。

    江尘被突如其来的话打断了静修,这才缓缓抬起头。眼前是一个衣着华丽的小女孩,精致的小脸蛋儿,水汪汪的大眼睛,活脱脱一个小美人。

    江尘笑了笑,这才有些苦涩的缓缓说道:“我是一个孤儿,自然没有人陪我来。”

    “原来如此,不过没关系的,以后我就是你的朋友了。”小女孩听到江尘的话,先是露出有些伤感的神情,随即又伸出雪白的手,落落大方的说道:“你好,我叫洛馨,很高兴认识你。”

    江尘先是一愣,随即面带微笑,伸出右手将洛馨的小手握住,才开心的说道:“我叫江尘,我也很高兴认识你,洛馨。”

    洛馨一点也不犹豫,直接坐在了江尘的身旁。从自己的包裹中取出一块精致的糕点,递到江尘的手中。
content_en:
Luo Shenzong, Shanmen.

    The huge mountain gate is a hundred feet high, with three large characters "Luoshen Sect" gilded in the center, and a line of small characters "Practice ten thousand ways and never forget your true heart" on the lower right. Every word seemed simple and vigorous, but it exuded a sharp sword energy that no one dared to look up at.

    At this moment, many people have gathered outside the gate of Luoshen Sect, all coming to participate in the selection of disciples of Luoshen Sect. Most of these people were young people, numbering in the tens of thousands, and the rest were servants or family members who came with them.

    Either in groups of three or five, or in pairs. Some looked anxious, while others looked very relaxed. Most of the young people who come to participate in the selection are in rich and colorful clothes. Obviously, there are very few young people with no background who can pass the selection.

    This is not because the Luoshen Sect dislikes the poor and loves the rich, or that someone accepts bribes. But for ordinary people's families, no matter how talented their children are, if they fail to activate the star power, it will be in vain. If you want to activate the star power, you must have a star formation master to arrange the traction star array to activate the star power.

    Generally, the time required to activate star power for the first time is very variable. The short one can successfully activate the star power in an hour, while the long one can take several months or even longer. Ordinary people don't have that much money to hire a Star Formation Master, so most of the disciples who have joined the Luo Shen Sect are descendants of aristocratic families.

    Jiang Chen's clothes were quite decent. Although not gorgeous, he still looked like a young master from a noble family. However, Jiang Chen felt a little envious as he walked alone among the crowd. Regardless of whether the young men in front of them came accompanied by family members or servants, at least they were accompanied by someone, but he was alone. This made Jiang Chen very envious, even a little jealous.

    Jiang Chen found an open space and sat down, trying to calm down his heart according to the meditation techniques taught by the old Taoist priests.

    "Why are you here alone? No one sent you here?" A little girl about ten years old blinked and stared at Jiang Chen curiously and asked.

    Jiang Chen was interrupted by the sudden words and then slowly raised his head. In front of me is a gorgeously dressed little girl, with a delicate little face and big watery eyes, she looks like a little beauty.

    Jiang Chen smiled, and then said slowly and bitterly: "I am an orphan, so naturally no one comes with me."

    "I see, but it doesn't matter. I will be your friend from now on." When the little girl heard Jiang Chen's words, she showed a somewhat sad expression at first, then stretched out her white hand and said calmly and generously: "Hello, my name is Luo Xin, nice to meet you."

    Jiang Chen was stunned for a moment, then with a smile on his face, he stretched out his right hand to hold Luo Xin's little hand, and then said happily: "My name is Jiang Chen, and I'm glad to meet you, Luo Xin."

    Luo Xin didn't hesitate at all and sat directly next to Jiang Chen. He took out a piece of delicate pastry from his package and handed it to Jiang Chen's hand.
